source: 原创练习材料；非官方完整题库、当季回忆真题或预测题。

questions.text: What do you like most about the area where you live?
Is there anything you would like to change about your home?
Do you prefer spending time at home or going out? Why?
Which part of your work or studies do you find most interesting?
Do you prefer working alone or with other people?
What would you like to learn in the future?
What do you usually do when you have some free time?
Have your hobbies changed since you were a child?
Is there a new hobby you would like to try?
What do you use your phone for most often?
Do you prefer sending messages or making phone calls?
Is there a piece of technology you find difficult to use?
How do you usually travel around your town or city?
Do you enjoy planning trips?
What kind of place would you like to visit next?
How often do you spend time outdoors?
What kind of weather do you enjoy most?
Is there a natural place near your home that you like?
What food do you enjoy eating most?
Do you like cooking for yourself?
Have your eating habits changed in recent years?
How do you usually keep in touch with your friends?
Do you enjoy meeting new people?
What do you like doing with your family or friends?
What kinds of films or programmes do you enjoy watching?
Do you prefer reading on a screen or on paper?
How do you usually find out about local events?
Do you like making plans for your day?
What do you do when your plans suddenly change?
Is there a daily habit you would like to change?
Describe a place in your town or city where you enjoy spending time.
questions.explain: why you enjoy spending time in this place.
closing: Would you like to take someone else to this place?
Has this place changed since you first visited it?

questions.text: Describe a useful skill you learned from another person.
questions.explain: how this skill has been useful to you.
closing: Do you still use this skill regularly?
Would you like to teach this skill to someone else?

questions.text: Describe an activity you tried for the first time and enjoyed.
points: when and where you tried it
closing: Would you like to do this activity again?
Was it easier or harder than you expected?

questions.text: Describe a time when technology helped you solve a problem.
questions.explain: why it was helpful in that situation.
closing: Have you used the same technology since then?
Would you recommend it to someone with a similar problem?

questions.text: Describe a journey that did not go as planned.
questions.explain: how you dealt with the unexpected situation.
closing: Would you make the same journey again?
Did the experience change the way you plan journeys?

questions.text: Describe an outdoor place that made a strong impression on you.
points: what you saw or did there
questions.explain: why you still remember this place.
closing: Would you like to visit this place again?
Would you recommend it to a friend?

questions.text: Describe a meal you shared with other people that you remember well.
points: when and where the meal took place
closing: Would you like to have a similar meal again?
Do you still see the people who were there?

questions.text: Describe a person who encouraged you to do something difficult.
points: what you were trying to do
closing: Are you still in touch with this person?
Have you thanked this person for their help?

questions.text: Describe a book, film or programme that changed the way you thought about something.
points: when you read or watched it
closing: Would you recommend it to other people?
Would you read or watch it again?

questions.text: Describe a decision you made that led to a positive change in your life.
questions.explain: why you think this was a good decision.
closing: Would you make the same decision again?
Did anyone help you make this decision?
